Name: Tim in SDV
Author: blazonix
Description:
Tim Drake comes to Stardew Valley in search of something important!...even though he says he's just a guy on vacation.
 
[b]
Important:[/b]

-If using the Ridgeside Village mod, the Redbird moves from the Bus Stop to the Backwoods.
       
-You can turn noses on or off on the sprites. You can do this with Generic Mod Config Menu or by editing the config file which is created when you first run the game.

-Turn off Extra Speech if you're not going to marry Tim or are divorcing him. This option overwrites generic dialogue used for all romanceable characters.

-Robin will show up in the Town Center after Festivals have ended. This is due to the game being confused which Robin is being used, no fix yet.

[b]FAQ:[/b]

Q: How do I install the mod manually?
A: Download the file and unzip it to your mod folder. For steam users, it usually looks like this: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

Q: How do I manually configure the options?
A: Open your mod folder (see above) and choose this mod's folder. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad. Type "True" where "False" is and save.

Q: There are problems using this mod with SVE!
A: First make sure it's SVE causing the conflict. I haven't tested it with other mods. If it's definitely SVE, let me know so I can fix it!

Q: There’s a genuine bug/problem/typo with the mod.
A: Let me know what it is, what mods you have running with it, and what triggered it. The more information I have, the better chance I have at fixing it.
 
Q: I’d like this mod to be compatible with <insert mod>.
A: I will certainly try to fulfill requests like these, but I’m not very skilled. I cannot guarantee I’ll be able to make this mod compatible with everything.
 
Q: Will you keep updating this mod?
A: Yes.
 
Q: Can I make my own assets or translations for this mod and publish it?
A: As long as you link this mod, I don’t see why not.
 
Q: Can I modify this mod to be like the Tim in my head and publish it?
A: Sorry, no. It’d feel like a slap in the face after all the work I put into this.
 
Q: Can you make <insert character here> a mod?
A: Sorry, I probably won't make any more custom NPC mods.

Q: Can I donate to you?
A: Absolutely! There's a donate button on my Nexusmods profile. Definitely don't feel like you have to though!
 
Q: Why Tim?
A: Why not? He’s my favorite Robin.
